data.title: Parkland
data.about:
Parkland at Dubai Hills Estate is an upcoming project by Emaar designed to provide luxury, comfort, and practicality. Each home offers a selection of 1, 2, and 3-bedroom apartments, featuring calming open spaces, modern kitchens, and luxurious bathrooms. 

Emaar’s Parkland master plan boasts world-class amenities, including indoor and outdoor gyms, swimming pools, play areas, communal spaces, and BBQ zones, catering to a vibrant and active lifestyle. Additionally, residents have direct access to Dubai Hills Park, the longest park-stretch in any community. They are just a short stroll away from Dubai Hills Golf Club and the expansive Dubai Hills Mall, making it an ideal choice for those seeking a blend of leisure, convenience, and luxury living​.

characteristics_module.title: Discover Luxury, Comfort, and Serenity at Parkland at Dubai Hills Estate
characteristics_module.heading: Unique Selling Points
characteristics_module.description:
• Eloquently designed 1, 2, and 3-bedroom apartments offering stunning views of Dubai Hills Park.
  • Spacious 209 units with covered area ranging from 742 sq. ft. to 1,841 sq. ft.
  • Parkland Emaar payment plans are quite flexible, and you can book an apartment with just a 20 per cent down payment.
  • Residents will enjoy excellent facilities, including indoor and outdoor gym, kids' play areas, BBQ zones, and more.
  • Direct access to the expansive Dubai Hills Park and the retail and dining hub, Dubai Hills Mall.

location_tile.title: Enjoy Breathtaking Views and Luxury Amenities at Parkland by Emaar
location_tile.heading: Location
location_tile.description:
Dubai Hills Estate is an exceptional residential community located in the green heart of Dubai, strategically positioned between Downtown Dubai and Dubai Marina. This masterfully planned, multi-purpose development forms an integral part of Mohammed Bin Rashid City and offers residents easy access to the city's most popular districts and attractions. 

The community is easily accessible by Al Khail Road, ensuring seamless connectivity to key spots like King's College Hospital, Dubai Hills Business Park, and Dubai Hills Mall.

Within Walking Distance from Dubai Hills Business Park
Within Walking Distance from Dubai Hills Mall
15 Minutes to Downtown Dubai
5 Minutes to King's College Hospital

These plans typically include an initial down payment followed by staggered installments throughout the construction period, with a significant portion due upon project completion, making it easier for buyers to manage their investments.
more_info.question: What are the payment plans available for Parkland by Emaar at Dubai Hills Estate?
